no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Atara has effectively divested or wound down all internally sponsored clinical development. (1) Tab-cel/Ebvallo: all manufacturing (Mar 2025), clinical (Jul 2025), and regulatory (Oct 2025) responsibility transferred to Pierre Fabre, who is now the sponsor of the ALLELE Phase 3 study and the tab-cel multi-cohort Phase 2 study and the U.S. tab-cel BLA; Atara retains only royalty/milestone economics. Second FDA Complete Response Letter received January 2026. (2) ATA3219 and ATA3431 CAR T programs paused/discontinued in March 2025 with wind-down nearly complete. (3) ATA188 and EBV vaccine returned to QIMR Berghofer in May 2025. (4) ATA2271 and ATA3271 returned to MSK in March 2024. Atara conducted 4 reductions in force in 2025 (50%, 50%, 30%, 30%) leaving ~15 employees and is exploring strategic alternatives.
